name: manual_d437ee
claim: State snapshots and resume helpers are not durable replay; local atomic state commit cannot roll back foreign effects.

decisions.notes: R3 checkpointer records state only, ainvoke restarts at START, and resume_policy mutates scratchpad without grants or cursor recovery. Durable replay requires lineage, frontier, fencing, effect identity and reconciliation before re-execution.
